propositions: The completion verifier pins the ticket store with fetch=False, reading a stale local mirror of refs/heads/tickets that is arbitrarily commits-behind origin/tickets, causing show_ticket to return outdated status and comment counts.

The verifier's context prompt comes from the live store while show_ticket reads the pinned snapshot, creating disagreement; the model correctly defers to the stale snapshot per documented authority, yielding false verdicts.

When reconcile_verdict produces a non-PASS verdict with no findings, it fabricates a placeholder criterion (unspecified) rather than reporting an indeterminate state, leaving operators with no remediation path.

Measured across two independent tickets (cb91 and d4c2), the stale pin blocked closes that should pass, manifesting as false missing-evidence claims and masked-budget-starvation symptoms that vanished after fix validation.
